Upbit disclosed a November 27, 2025 compromise of a Solana hot wallet that enabled unauthorized withdrawals across multiple Solana ecosystem assets. Public reporting initially estimated losses near $36 million before later exchange statements revised the stolen value to 44.5 billion won with partial freezing and reimbursement from corporate reserves. No official forensic report, attacker wallet set, or verified transaction history has been publicly released.
